title: BUGFIX — fal.ai ETIMEDOUT circuit breaker (stop wasting 150s per scene when API down)
rationale: fal.ai ETIMEDOUT happening for all scenes in a run (19:26–19:38 log). Each failed scene wastes 150s (Node execSync timeout) × 2 models = 300s per scene. With 6 scenes = 30 min wasted. Pipeline already falls back to color blocks correctly. Fix: circuit breaker in fal-video-client.ts — after 2 consecutive ETIMEDOUT failures, throw immediately so callers reach color fallback in <1s instead of 150s.

tasks.description: Add circuit breaker to fal-video-client.ts: module-level counter, after 2 consecutive ETIMEDOUT errors skip fal.ai immediately with clear message. Reset counter on success. Check err.code === 'ETIMEDOUT' OR err.message includes 'ETIMEDOUT' OR err.message includes 'spawnSync'.
